title: Sovereign Data Armor: Auto-heal policy-as-code & evidence bundling
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Build an integrated policy-as-code enforcement and automated compliance evidence pipeline focused on data residency and retention settings. Deliverables: (1) a compact policy evaluation engine (Rego-like) that compiles residency+retention rules into executable checks, (2) continuous config-drift detectors that score and surface divergent platform resources (buckets, routes, model deployments) using config hashes and ML anomaly scoring, (3) an automated remediation runner that supports shadow-enforce, staged canary fixes, and auditable rollback, and (4) signed evidence bundles (zip of diffs, evaluation results, remediation trace, KMS-attested signatures) that can be exported to auditors or fed into the Console compliance dashboard.
acceptance_criteria: Policy engine can evaluate residency and retention assertions against a mocked tenant graph with <200ms P90 latency
Drift detector produces actionable score and classification for sampled resources with >85% precision in test harness
Auto-remediator supports 3 remediation modes: suggest, shadow-enforce (no-op with audit logs), and staged-apply with canary percentage and automatic rollback on errors
Evidence bundle generator produces a tamper-evident artifact (SHA256 manifest + KMS signature) and a human-readable summary linked in Console
E2E test: simulate region-misplacement and expired-retention; system generates evidence bundle and runs staged remediation with rollback within the configured window
risk_and_mitigation: Risk: aggressive auto-remediation could cause service interruption. Mitigation: default to suggest/shadow modes; require explicit opt-in for staged-apply at org level and a kill-switch integration with PagerDuty.
Risk: false positives from drift ML. Mitigation: tune model with holdout datasets, add confidence threshold and manual approval gate for high-impact resources.

Risk: evidence tampering. Mitigation: sign manifests with customer KMS when available and include chain-of-actions in the bundle; store artifact immutably in compliance storage bucket with write-once lifecycle.
Risk: privacy of evidence bundles. Mitigation: redact PII automatically and include provenance only; encrypt bundles at rest with envelope encryption and limit access via RBAC policies.
